title: Choreographing phased feature experiments and maturity gates
creator: Priya Singh
description: Goal: define a repeatable, cross-functional playbook and concrete milestones for running phased feature experiments (A/B and canary-style ramps) for Redwood Console and runtime changes. This ticket captures the orchestration artifact: rollout schedule templates, gating thresholds, evaluation windows, instrumentation checklist, communication steps, and post-mortem triggers. Context: several recent rollouts (model variant routing, KV cache opt) lacked consistent early-warning gates and evaluation cadence, resulting in noisy rollbacks and ambiguous root-cause signals. Deliverables: 1) canonical rollout template, 2) instrumentation checklist and dashboard links, 3) clear abort/rollforward criteria, 4) signoff matrix for rapid canaries and A/B experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical rollout template documented in Confluence with example schedules for small/medium/large traffic fractions
Instrumentation checklist covers token-level cost, latency (p50/p95/p99), error rates, model output quality evals, and user-facing errors
Dashboard with phase-level widgets (traffic split, key SLOs, regression counts) is available and linked
Abort and rollback criteria are quantifiable and reviewed by infra and runtime teams
Communication/incident playbook (who paged & how) exists and is acknowledged by stakeholders
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (smoke, internal): 100% internal traffic, 1 hour burn-in
Phase 1 (canary): 1% of production traffic, 6 hour evaluation window, no config changes allowed
Phase 2 (ramp): 5% -> 20% over 24 hours, evaluate after each step using evaluation milestones
Phase 3 (broad): 50% for 72 hours with continuous monitoring; promote to 100% only if all gates pass
Emergency abort: immediate 100% rollback if critical gate tripped (see gates below)
evaluation_milestones: T+1h (smoke): sanity checks on logs, errors, and critical traces
T+6h (canary end): compare p95 latency and error rate vs baseline; run quality eval on sample of prompts
T+24h (ramp check): cost delta assessment and correctness regression check on golden prompt set
T+72h (stability): retention of improvements or stable regressions; final signoff decision
gating_thresholds: Abort if overall error rate increases > 0.25 percentage points AND absolute error rate > 0.5%
Abort if p95 latency increases > 30% relative to baseline for more than 15 minutes
Abort if model-quality regressions exceed 2% of golden prompt set (semantic drift or hallucination increase)
Defer ramp for human-reviewed regressions until triage is complete
telemetry_and_dashboards: Logging query templates and saved runs: https://logs.redwood-inference.internal/queries/pm-9310
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Insufficient telemetry coverage for new model variant. Mitigation: block phase 1 until PR #1482 merged and smoke queries validated
Risk: False-positive quality regressions due to sampling bias. Mitigation: use stratified golden set and manual review for first two ramps
Risk: Rollout causes cascade in downstream batching service. Mitigation: include batching P95/P99 in gates and reserve emergency capacity
links: Design notes for Console UX for experiment flags: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ux_design_notes_pm9310
